records.body:

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome to Wrenfield! Your workspace is ready. A good first step is to create your first project and invite a teammate.

If anything's unclear, just reply here.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Kai created a first project on day 5 and held the welcome call (calendar:43a9151d), showing real engagement, but no invite sent and no key milestone with 8 days left; two outreach emails (email:1b7efa37, email:eb58ea50) drew no reply, and no tickets filed, so self-serve progress is plausible but uncertain.

draft.subject: Nice to talk on Monday — one next step
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for making time for the welcome call on Monday, and nice work getting your first project created. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding your real work into that project is usually the quickest way to see where it helps.

If it would help to have a teammate in there with you, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that first step with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Nadia
